Consequently any fair core query has D_iF-pi D_ig=Psi_pi(a)-mean Psi_pi(a_b). For the four-single-bit controller A=WUV OR S(U OR V), retain A046 v3 U, and carry one original full product-projection reference Q of F by the same actual signed child kernel to Q_b, with one explicit reset to child product projections R_b. For core g=(-1,1,1,1),i=0, R in (3429/100000,7/200), B_old in (1/40,13/500)<R, B_new>19/100, signed reset sigma=mean D(P_b||R_b)-mean D(P_b||Q_b)<-1/6; thus R<B_new/5 and B_new-R>31/200 without spending erasure credit.
